claims.claim: An assistant decision with no supersedes, or with an unrelated target, can no longer replace a user decision at the same coordinate through validate → plan → apply.
claims.harness: 16-case matrix; real validator, planner and reducer
claims.configuration: assistant decision vs user decision; no supersedes, unrelated target, same-packet conflict, mixed source, stale quote
claims.limitation: Deterministic contract only; it says nothing about model behaviour or product quality. The stale-source rule uses message order, not semantic entailment.

claims.claim: The 96 E2E failures split into 17 produce, 13 write, 12 schema and 5 verify; no failure can be shown to be an observation failure from the recorded text.
claims.harness: offline reconstruction from reports, 25 ordered trajectories and request previews
claims.configuration: the six E2E campaigns as executed; no new call
claims.limitation: Post hoc. C is unknown in 35 of the 96 memory-task cells because tool text was truncated; 5 cells produced a value with no visible source in tool, checkpoint or prompt. New runs capture full primary messages, so C is decidable.

claims.claim: An archive locator resolves to the archived message it names, distinguishes two reads of one path, refuses a missing bundle, another session and a digest mismatch, and drops an untrusted argument.
claims.harness: 11-case suite over the real bundle store and recall path
claims.configuration: archiveLocator on for the contract test; default off
claims.limitation: It proves the address is correct and bounded, not that a model uses it. A three-locator section costs ~169 tokens by chars/4.

claims.claim: All 22 task instances fail initially, pass with the reference, fail with the counterfactual, and seed above the pressure threshold.
claims.harness: the E2E checker and seed meter
claims.limitation: Certification is offline. The four new templates then ran; T10 was found ambiguous during the pilot, fixed and re-certified, but the confirm used the pre-fix version and its T10 cells are excluded.

claims.claim: The L×G design was frozen as 120 cells (6 templates × 2 seeds × 2 replicates × 5 arms) with an 18-cell reserve, then executed under a separate 138-cell grant.
claims.harness: zero-request preflight, then the native host
claims.limitation: The design is the pre-registration; the execution and its T10 exclusion are recorded in ablation-analysis.json.

claims.claim: The 96-cell raw evidence is preserved in a 1,224-file, 38 MB package with a verified git bundle and zero credentials found by the scan.
claims.harness: copy + SHA256SUMS + git bundle verify + credential scan
claims.limitation: The archive is external; the repository carries only its hashes. The scan covers text files, not the compressed bundle.

claims.claim: The EF-R1 tarball installs and mounts basic/economy/quality with semantic continuity off, and contains no raw run, credential or checkout path.
claims.limitation: Construction and composition only; no provider request and no behavioural claim.

claims.claim: In the 120-cell L×G campaign, E0 9/24, E0-L 15/24, E0-G 15/24, E0-LG 16/24 and E1 18/24 passed; excluding the defective T10 fixture, no L/G arm is significant at 0.05.
claims.harness: native E2E host, 6 templates × 2 seeds × 2 replicates × 5 arms
claims.configuration: E0, E0-L, E0-G, E0-LG, E1; 16,384-token operational budget
claims.datasetVersion: 120 cells; T10 excluded from the primary estimate
claims.limitation: One model, one route, one machine; 10-12 task instances per comparison. The task prompt was folded in 44/120 cells, so the L/G estimate is confounded by task recovery.

claims.claim: The active task prompt was archived during the continuation in 44 of 120 confirmatory cells (27 of 100 excluding T10).
claims.limitation: Measured from the recorded primary requests; a checkpoint that paraphrases the prompt is not counted as the prompt. The rate may differ at another budget.

claims.claim: Eight state writers are classified and the 180-pair authority/source invariant passes: a displaced head is exactly a mayRetire-allowed replacement.
claims.limitation: The privileged anchor-service retire remains a runtime operation with no claiming identity; it is classified, not removed.

claims.claim: The combined 240-cell research archive has 3,018 files, a verified git bundle, zero credentials, and a second verified copy on another local volume.
claims.harness: copy + SHA256SUMS + bundle verify + credential scan
claims.limitation: The second copy is another volume on this machine, not an off-machine backup.

claims.claim: With the fixed T10 fixture, E0 0/2, E0-L 0/2, E0-G 2/2, E0-LG 1/2 and E1 2/2 passed.
claims.harness: 10 cells inside the confirm envelope reserve
claims.configuration: fixed T10, one replicate, five arms
claims.limitation: n=2 per arm; a fault retest, not a powered estimate. E0-L fails with task-prompt loss; E0-LG once writes a wrong shape.

claims.claim: Moving the leaf start after the active request preserved the prompt (4/4) and E0-P passed 3/4 vs E0 0/4, but every E0-P cell was an economic refusal (no fold).
claims.datasetVersion: 8 cells (4 pairs), plus an invalid first attempt
claims.limitation: The treatment is no-fold, not fold-with-protected-request: retained ~18–19k tokens. Span-start protection is rejected as a compression policy; re-render the active request after a normal fold is the next candidate.

claims.claim: Folding normally and copying the active request into the checkpoint body passed 4/4 vs 1/4 for E0, with the prompt lost 0/4 vs 4/4 and no economic refusals.
claims.limitation: n=4 pairs; a direction check. T9-s2 passed in both arms, so the three flips are T9-s1 and both T10 seeds. No product claim.

claims.claim: The 24-cell pilot, 120-cell confirm, 10-cell T10 retest, 8-cell prompt repair and 8-cell re-render pilot ran under separate grants and none exceeded its request/token/time caps.
claims.configuration: pilot 32-cell cap; confirm 138-cell cap; retest from its reserve; two 8-cell prompt grants
claims.datasetVersion: 170 valid new cells; 8 invalid first-attempt cells (0 requests)
claims.limitation: A constraint on this round, not evidence about the product.

note: The C0 registry is unchanged. This file adds EF-R1 claims; a missing artifact is reported, never inferred.
